$comment: The local player's SPAWN record, exported from the committed capture by scripts/export-spawn-template.py; do not hand-edit. A CAPTURED template, not a composed message: its 48 fragment payloads are per-component encodings whose codecs are still open, so the only honest way to serve it is verbatim with provenance. The capture is redacted (see `redacted`), so some bytes are placeholders.
preamble_note: 17 bytes precede the bundle and are a datagram-level preamble this crate does not model: this block is the first message of its datagram. The typed marker is NOT intact — the byte at offset 16 is 0x0d, not the marker's leading 0x00 — so bundle::decode accepts no offset of this block. The sibling block 0x2a_T0x8_R.bin carries the same bundle with an intact marker at offset 0 and 0x25_T0x8_R.bin[17:] equals 0x2a_T0x8_R.bin[1:] byte for byte.
actor_id_note: The 16 bytes at payload offset 29731 are the local player's actor id, verified by the four-byte <00 00 00 02> that precedes it at 29727 and by the independent live measurement in research/docs/PRIVATE-CLIENT-RUNBOOK.md (1a954abc4b3185bfbe37c3d8592618e0).

position.note: Two big-endian f32. The position exists ONLY in this spawn variant; the 9-fragment ongoing record carries none (see azoth-wire::player_record).

redacted.note: The capture replaced these bytes with XX; they are 0x00 in the payload. The prototype replays the same redacted bytes and reaches InGame, so this is the shape that is proven — but these bytes are placeholders, not captured values.

notes: boundaries is null on purpose: a fragment carries no length field, so the 48 fragment boundaries cannot be computed from the payload. research/derived/state-bundle-fragments.json is a census of the 9-fragment ONGOING record only; no spawn census exists, so the boundaries were NOT invented.
fragment_count 48 is the client's own measured nested-call count for this record (research/docs/JAVELIN-PROTOCOL.md §2e), not a guess from the bytes.

The prototype transmits this payload chunked (REPLAY_CHUNK_SIZE 1100) inside the type-0x08 bundle; the record payload is what this fixture carries, so a caller re-wraps it with azoth-wire::bundle::encode.
